# MediaX

> MediaX is a leading integrated digital marketing, creative, and performance agency based in Delhi NCR, India. With 8+ years of industry experience and 250+ clients served, MediaX operates as a unified network of specialised companies delivering full-funnel marketing solutions, brand identity, performance advertising, OOH, and creative production.

## Core Services

- **Digital Marketing & Strategy**: Full-funnel digital strategy, lead generation, and omnichannel growth marketing for D2C, B2B, healthcare, education, retail, and corporate brands.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Local Delhi SEO, technical SEO audits, enterprise SEO, e-commerce optimization, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO).
- **Google Ads & Performance Marketing (PPC)**: High-ROI paid search, shopping ads, Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram Ads), conversion rate optimization (CRO), and data-driven scaling.
- **Creative & Brand Identity**: Brand guidelines, logo design, heist-inspired and contemporary visual identities, packaging, and brand positioning.
- **Social Media Marketing (SMM)**: Social media strategy, content creation, community management, viral reels, and influencer campaigns.
- **Website Design & UI/UX Development**: Modern high-converting websites, Shopify e-commerce stores, custom web apps, and interactive digital experiences.
- **Film, Photography & Production**: High-production brand films, commercial shoots, podcast recording, and studio production.
- **Out-of-Home (OOH) Advertising**: Strategic billboard placements, ambient advertising, transit media, and high-impact physical activations across Delhi NCR and pan-India.

## Network of Specialised Companies

- **MediaX Performance+**: Specialized performance marketing division focused on data-driven advertising, conversion optimization, and measurable revenue growth (https://performanceplus.mediax.co.in/).
- **Happening In**: Premier city and entertainment discovery guide uncovering local food, lifestyle, events, and viral cultural trends (https://www.instagram.com/happeningin.official).
- **MediaX OOH**: Out-of-Home advertising and strategic brand presence across prime metropolitan locations (https://www.instagram.com/mediaxooh/).
- **MediaX Click**: Creative production studio offering curated sets, podcast studios, and end-to-end shoot support for brands and content creators (https://click.mediax.co.in/).
